next.reason: §2023:8.3.3.3.2 SR3: a literal 'shall not contain more than one decimal point', the assumed point, and no rightmost point, as in 1985. §2023:8.3.3.3.2 GR4: 'An integer literal is a fixed-point numeric literal that contains no decimal point'. Quoted digits are an alphanumeric literal: format 8.3.3.2.2 with §2023:8.3.3.2.4 GR2 'Alphanumeric literals are of the class and category alphanumeric' (1985 'nonnumeric'). Floating-point literals are an addition. Same programs, same meaning.
